decisions.reason: Report cites running-processes.txt PID 42432 (dsh web host) as the koffi.node holder and explains the loaded native binary stays locked until host exit, causing npm EBUSY on copyfile.
Explains a browser refresh only reloads the SPA while the host that loaded koffi keeps running, and gives an ordered stop-verify-install-restart sequence in numbered steps.
Grounded in npm-dist-tags.txt: unpinned install resolves to the latest tag (0.1.1-rc.2), alpha holds 0.1.2-alpha.5; states this downgrades/replaces alpha.4 rather than preserving it.
Provides npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 and @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui after stopping the host, verifies dsh --version prints alpha.5, and restarts the host.
Advises README authors to never publish a bare unpinned dsh install and to pin exact versions (both packages if combined), avoiding silent latest-tag downgrades of prereleases.
